description: PSLQ uniqueness probe for N_v on the path-α extended basis {q, [k]_q for k=2..10, small primes}. Tests at four tolerances spanning 1e-100 down to 1e-7 (CODATA G_F floor).
conclusion: Inconclusive. PSLQ at tol < 1e-7 finds no relation involving log(N_v); at tol = 1e-7 (CODATA noise floor) only spurious noise-fits with large coefficients are returned. The path-α structural identification (W=T(2,4), Z=T(2,6), H=T(2,8)) is verified PSD-feasible (ew_higgs_sdp_probe.witness.json) but does not yield a clean q-arithmetic closed form for N_v in this basis. Closure requires authoring prop:weak-spectral-completeness with explicit Plancherel weights, OR higher-precision CODATA G_F (not currently available).
